hypotheses.construction_plan: Define kernel K(theta)=V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta). Instantiate at theta=p and theta=q; the raw summands are K(p) and K(q), and their sum is the observed expression.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are unary functions that can be evaluated at p and q
The product V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta) is treated as the same AC product as G0(theta)*V(theta)^2
hypotheses.rationale: Both non-identical summands are the same product of V, G0, and V with only the free symbol changed; this is a repeated kernel with a single parameter theta.
